NVDA.name: NVIDIA Corporation
NVDA.ai_strategy_one_line_zh: 以CUDA软件栈与数据中心级AI基础设施平台，通过软硬件协同设计赋能全行业AI。
NVDA.ai_strategy_one_line_en: Data-center-scale AI infrastructure platform with CUDA software stack and extreme co-design for all industries.
concrete_bets: Extreme co-design of chips, networking, systems, software

MSFT.name: Microsoft Corporation
MSFT.ai_strategy_one_line_zh: 以Microsoft Cloud为核心，构建覆盖全栈的AI平台，通过Copilot和智能体提升生产力并确保负责任与安全的AI。
MSFT.ai_strategy_one_line_en: Build a full-stack AI platform on Microsoft Cloud, driving productivity with Copilot and agents while ensuring responsible, secure AI.
concrete_bets: Intelligent cloud and intelligent edge platform
Integrated AI-driven security, compliance, and identity

PLTR.name: Palantir Technologies Inc.
PLTR.ai_strategy_one_line_zh: 通过AIP将大模型集成到Gotham和Foundry平台，为政府与企业提供安全可用的AI决策操作系统。
PLTR.ai_strategy_one_line_en: Integrates LLMs into Gotham and Foundry via AIP to deliver secure AI decision-making for government and enterprise.

META.name: Meta Platforms, Inc.
META.ai_strategy_one_line_zh: 以AI驱动社交与沉浸式体验，投资基础模型、Meta AI助手及AI眼镜等硬件。
META.ai_strategy_one_line_en: AI-driven social and immersive experiences via foundation models, Meta AI assistant, and AI glasses.

themes.evidence_one_line_zh: 围绕 Codex/Claude Code 等编码智能体的插件、AGENTS.md 约定与本地开源模型替代方案展开
themes.evidence_one_line_en: Plugins, AGENTS.md conventions, and local open-weight coding agents as alternatives to Claude Code and Codex.

themes.evidence_one_line_zh: OpenAI 展示法律、广告、数据分析等垂直行业的 ChatGPT 企业级产品与价值衡量
themes.evidence_one_line_en: OpenAI showcases vertical ChatGPT enterprise products in law, ads, and analytics, plus usage-to-value analytics.

themes.evidence_one_line_zh: 涵盖 Gemini 越狱事件、拒绝机制细分、青少年安全蓝图及模型失准报告框架等安全议题
themes.evidence_one_line_en: Gemini breakout hack, targeted refusals, youth safety blueprint, and a model misalignment reporting framework.

themes.evidence_one_line_zh: 聚焦缩放定律、循环 Transformer、推理努力控制、GRPO/LoRA 微调与文本检测器训练
themes.evidence_one_line_en: Scaling laws, looped transformers, reasoning-effort control, GRPO/LoRA fine-tuning, and detector training.

themes.evidence_one_line_zh: 探讨智能体自我改进、任务可复现性、信念更新、数据系统与工具使用数据集生成等系统性问题
themes.evidence_one_line_en: Self-improvement, task repeatability, belief updating, data systems for agents, and tool-use dataset generation.
